biblical_reference.note: Tova is a name mentioned in the Hebrew Bible. In Genesis 29:35, it is the name of Rachel's daughter. In Exodus 3:2, Moses asks God what name he should use when speaking to the Israelites, and God replies, 'I am He who is.' Moses then asked what he should tell the Israelites to say when they meet God. God said, 'Tell them this: 'I am has sent me to you.'' The name Tova is not explicitly mentioned in the passage, but it is implied that it is one of the names for God, meaning 'good'.
